description: This file contains performance testing scripts for comparing Azure OpenAI SDK and a custom router, focusing on streaming completion times and ensuring minimal latency difference.

methods.name: _openai_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous completion request to the Azure OpenAI client and measures time to first token.

methods.name: _router_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous completion request via the custom router and measures time to first token.

methods.name: test_azure_completion_streaming
methods.description: Orchestrates multiple concurrent streaming completion tests for both methods to compare their latency.
